name: mrvc-vendor-ffi
description: FFI runtime shipped inside the vsix (the POSIX WCH-Link hardware bridge). koffi is installed here — NOT in the root node_modules — because vsce's .vscodeignore cannot re-include a negated subtree, so this directory is shipped whole (pruned by .vscodeignore to the JS entry + the linux_x64/darwin_arm64 prebuilds).
